ingredients.raw_kh: ខ្ទឹមបារាំង
ពពុះសណ្ដែក
ត្រចៀកកណ្តុរ

steps.text_kh: សាច់សុទ្ធហាន់ជាបន្ទះស្តើងចិញ្ច្រាំឱ្យល្អិត មីសួរ ត្រចៀកកណ្តុរ ពពុះសណ្ដែកត្រាំទឹកឱ្យរីកកាត់ឱ្យខ្លី។ ស្រង់ទុកឱ្យស្រសទឹក
steps.text_en: Mince the lean pork finely; soak glass noodles, wood ear, and bean sprouts until soft, cut short, and drain well.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer cha dish Cha Mi Sour (Stir-fried Glass Noodles), step 1: Mince the lean pork finely; soak glass noodles, wood ear, and bean sprouts until soft, cut short, and drain well.

steps.text_kh: យកខ្លាញ់ដាក់ខ្ទឹមសចិញ្ច្រាំឆាឱ្យឈ្ងុយ ដាក់សាច់ជ្រកឆា ចាក់ទឹកត្រី ស្ករ អំបិល ម្សៅស៊ុប
steps.text_en: Heat oil and fry minced garlic until fragrant; stir-fry the pork; add fish sauce, sugar, salt, and soup powder.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer cha dish Cha Mi Sour (Stir-fried Glass Noodles), step 2: Heat oil and fry minced garlic until fragrant; stir-fry the pork; add fish sauce, sugar, salt, and soup powder.

steps.text_kh: ដាក់ខ្ទឹមបារាំងហាន់បណ្តោយចំណិត ដាក់មីសួរ ត្រចៀកកណ្តុរ ឆាឱ្យឆ្អិន
steps.text_en: Add sliced onion, glass noodles, and wood ear; stir-fry until cooked.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer cha dish Cha Mi Sour (Stir-fried Glass Noodles), step 3: Add sliced onion, glass noodles, and wood ear; stir-fry until cooked.

steps.text_kh: វាយពងទាចាក់ចូលឆាឱ្យសព្វ រោយម្រេចបន្តិច ភ្លក់មើលឱ្យល្មមតាមចូលចិត្ត
steps.text_en: Beat the duck egg and pour in; scramble until set; add black pepper; taste and adjust to preference.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer cha dish Cha Mi Sour (Stir-fried Glass Noodles), step 4: Beat the duck egg and pour in; scramble until set; add black pepper; taste and adjust to preference.
